messages:
oliver: Heads up — customer (acct: acme-inc) reports Google SSO failing in prod on mobile Chrome. Getting 'missing_state' at callback. https://app.redwood.example/auth/callback?error=missing_state
maria: Do we have the exact callback URL they hit and an example state? Any proxy in front?
oliver: Pasted the redirect they got:
```
https://app.redwood.example/auth/callback?code=4/0AX4XfW...&state=eyJhbGciOiJ...%2F...%25
```
State looks truncated — ends with `%25` which is odd.
sre_oncall: Can you check Cloudflare / CDN workers? We rolled an edge change yesterday that rewrites some querystrings for caching.
ingrid: Confirmed there was a workers change for url-canonicalization. It normalizes plus/space and has a 2000 char branch. Could be splitting encoded values.
oliver: Repro steps from customer: 1) Start login on mobile Chrome 2) Redirect to Google 3) Consent 4) Redirect back to our callback — intermittently fails (~10% of attempts). Desktop seems fine.
maria: Any logs from the callback handler showing raw querystring? Need request.raw_query_string and headers (CF-Connecting-*).
support-bot: Ticket SUP-7684 created and assigned to support oncall.
oliver: Callback raw capture shows this pattern:
```
code=4%2F...&state=eyJ...part1%25
# next packet
state=part2...
```
So the encoded state is being split and our handler reads the first `state=` only and fails PKCE/state verify.
ingrid: That matches the worker behavior — it was splitting long encoded tokens and emitting them as separate `state` params when `%` sequences cross internal buffer boundaries. Bug in the rewrite script.
sre_oncall: Short-term mitigation: update the callback handler to coalesce multiple `state` params (concatenate in arrival order) and then URL-decode before PKCE validation. Also schedule immediate rollback of the worker change.
maria: I'll open a small hotfix PR to merge duplicate `state` params and add a defensive length check. Will do canary deploy to staging then prod.
oliver: Customer is OK with temporary workaround and wants ETA. Told them ~2-3 hours for hotfix canary then monitor. :thumbsup:
ingrid: Long-term fix: update worker to not split querystrings, add integration test for long encoded state + mobile user-agent + CDN.
support-bot: Notifying owners: @sre_oncall @ingrid @maria
